AUTHOR: Lopez-Vazquez
TITLE: Video Image Enhancement and Machine Learning Pipeline for Underwater Animal Detection and Classification at Cabled Observatories
REGION: LoVe Ocean Observatory, Hola trough off Lofoten Islands, Norway (~260 m, cold-water coral reef)
SPECIES: 13 classes: rockfish (Sebastes sp.), eel-like fish (Brosme brosme), generic fish, king crab, squid, starfish, hermit crab, anemone, shrimp, sea urchin, crab, coral (Desmophyllum pertusum), plus 'turbidity' and 'shadow' classes
DATA: Own LoVe Satellite 1 time-lapse stills (60-min interval), Oct 2017-Jun 2018 and Dec 2018-Jun 2019; 8,818 images; 1,934 annotated elements (train 1,547 augmented to 39,072)
V_EV: Sec 2.4: 'acquired in an uncontrolled environment ... where turbidity and artificial lighting changes make it difficult to detect elements'; Sec 1.3: 'in the Barents sea at 260 m depth'
D2: 80/20 (1,547 train elements); 10-fold cross-validation with classes evenly distributed per fold
D_EV: Sec 2.6: 'every classifier was validated by 10-fold cross-validation by considering that the elements of each class were distributed evenly in each one of the folds.'
R_EV: Sec 3: count check 'performed on images not used during the training and test phase, corresponding to the period from 17 November 2017 to 22 November 2017' (same observatory/camera)
E_EV: Sec 3: 'DNN-1 was used to extract the time series of organism abundance ... The classifier detected rockfish in 27 images, whereas with the manual detection, animals were detected in 24 images'
ARCH: CLAHE + bilateral filtering + daily background subtraction + binary thresholding/contours; global features (Hu moments, Haralick, colour histogram) classified by SVM, K-NN, DT, RF, small CNNs and DNNs (best DNN-1)
METR: Accuracy, AUC (macro), loss, confusion matrices, training time; daily detection time series vs manual
NOTE: Multi-taxa megafauna study; fish are a minority of classes (Sebastes, Brosme brosme, generic fish) - TAXA coded on fish classes; NCLASS=13 includes non-fish, turbidity and shadow classes. V: 'turbidity' treated as an image class and described qualitatively; observatory measures turbidity (Satellite 1) but values are not used/reported -> V1=정성 서술만; depth 260 m and artificial lighting -> V_ALL=P. D: train/test by element (80% augmented) and 10-fold CV of elements -> D1=k-fold(이미지), D_ALL=N; the 6-day abundance check used a separate period (17-22 Nov 2017) but same observatory/campaign -> not external (P2). C: only a segmentation binary threshold chosen 'by testing different values' (not a confidence score); count check notes 'at least three false positives' inferred from 27 vs 24 images - not treated as a verified FP-rate sample (if accepted as C5=검증 표본 오탐률 with C1=NR, C_ALL=P). E: rockfish 27 vs 24 images over 80 images, other taxa 'difference is much higher'. NIMG = 1,934 annotated elements (8,818 raw images).
